source.citation: Chen, D. (2015). Online Retail. UCI Machine Learning Repository. DOI:10.24432/C5BW33

selection: First 10000 transaction rows in source worksheet order; not random or representative.
adaptation: Drop Description/Country; hash invoice/product/customer IDs with a public namespace; retain missing IDs and all negative/cancelled/zero-price records; add cancellation flag and documented GBP currency.
privacy_limit: Deterministic hashes are pseudonyms, not a guarantee of anonymization; public IDs can be guessed. Raw inputs remain local.
limitations: Public historical retail data, not a participating portfolio company or independently labeled financial benchmark. Quantity-times-price is an extract control sum, not recognized revenue. No mapping, certified metrics, adoption, time saving or business impact is established.
